name: headertweaker
description: Lightweight browser extension that lets you easily modify outgoing HTTP headers
author: Maurice Kappelhof

scripts.dev:firefox: BROWSER=firefox vite build && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "BROWSER=firefox vite build --watch" "web-ext run --source-dir=dist/firefox"
scripts.dev:firefox:console: BROWSER=firefox vite build && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "BROWSER=firefox vite build --watch" "web-ext run --source-dir=dist/firefox --browser-console"
scripts.dev:chrome: BROWSER=chrome vite build && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "BROWSER=chrome vite build --watch" "web-ext run --target=chromium --source-dir=dist/chrome"
scripts.dev:chrome:console: BROWSER=chrome vite build && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "BROWSER=chrome vite build --watch" "web-ext run --target=chromium --source-dir=dist/chrome --browser-console"
scripts.build:all: pnpm run build:firefox && pnpm run build:chrome
